articles.title: Live updates: Bitcoin drops more than 5% as stocks close out worst day since April 2025
articles.snippet: The continued blowup of the AI trade led markets lower, with Nvidia losing 9.3% and many other chip names down double-digit percentages.

articles.title: Crypto ally French Hill wins reelection but set to lose House chair
articles.snippet: Republican French Hill secured another term in Congress but will lose his leadership of the House Financial Services Committee when Democrats take control in January.

articles.title: Can decentralized phone networks power the AI revolution?
articles.snippet: Decentralized AI networks want to turn everyday phones into an alternative to centralized computing infrastructure — but skeptics have their doubts.

articles.title: ‘Lawyer up’: Democrats target Trump, Big Tech after midterm sweep
articles.snippet: Democrats wasted little time after their midterm victory, warning tech CEOs to prepare for subpoenas and signaling fresh investigations into Trump’s business dealings.

articles.title: US Voters Back AI Data Center Restrictions in At Least 29 Communities
articles.snippet: Voters across the United States backed measures to curb data centers, raising new obstacles for the infrastructure powering AI as electricity bills, water supplies, and public oversight dominate the debate.
